facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition reports the inauguration on 2 October 2025 at Grand-Bassam (VITIB) of ST Digital's data centre, built to international Tier III norms, to host data of administrations and private companies.

CIV.note: Only a general statement that data centres are the base of digital sovereignty; no plan, rule or state hosting in service is stated.
Tier III is a facility claim, not a standards adoption.
The operator is a pan-African group; national ownership is not stated.
